item.title: langchain 1.6.7
item.description: breaking / deprecated wording Breaking keyword in a patch release Quote: `initChatModel` with a model and no `configurableFields` (and direct `new ConfigurableModel(...)` without it) no longer lets `configurable.model` / `configurable.modelProvider` swap the model at invoke time, matching the docs.
